indicator_name: Government yield-curve slopes, spreads to the base rate, real 10-year yield (computed by this repository)
description: Наклон кривой доходности ГЦБ, спреды к базовой ставке, реальная доходность на 10 лет (расчёт репозитория)
methodology: From GS_YIELD_3M … GS_YIELD_10Y (KASE zero-coupon curve, monthly, from 2019-11), TONIA and BASE_RATE (monthly means) and INFLATION_EXPECTATIONS. A negative slope = an inverted curve (the market prices rate cuts). The sovereign US-dollar spread is KZ_EUROBOND_SPREAD (KASE), the tenge-dollar differentials are KZT_USD_RATE_DIFF_*.
